content: निर्यूहः .²1 A pinnacle, turret, projection (on columns or gates); अनेकविधप्रासादहर्म्यवलभीनिर्यूहशतसंकुलम् (अपश्यत्) <ls>Mb. 1. 3. 133</ls>; वितर्दिनिर्यूहविटङ्कनीडः <ls>Śi. 3. 55</ls>. (where Mālli. renders निर्यूह by मत्तवारणाख्य अपाश्रयः and quotes Vaijayantī; perhaps it was so called from its resemblance to the shape of an elephant in rut); चारुतोरणनिर्यूहा <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 A chaplet, crest, head-ornament; बद्धाभरणनिर्यूहाः <ls>Mb. 5. 155. 12</ls>. .²3 A peg projecting from a wall. .²4 Wood placed in a wall for pigeons to build their nests or to perch upon; <ls>Śi. 3. 55</ls>. .²5 A door, gate. .²6 Extract, decoction.
